name: @vrmxg/editor-ui
description: The Vue components the editor and the creator share (M4 W5): the timeline (moved out of apps/editor), the storyboard strip, the render queue panel, and the inspector's widgets (M5 W4: a number field you drag, fields generated from a prop's JSON Schema), over @vrmxg/editor-core's model. What an edit becomes is plain functions, tested in Node; the components are compiled and rendered on the server in the tests.
